answered.sql: SELECT E.employee_name, E.position, FY.year AS founding_year FROM Employees E JOIN Healthcare_Facilities HF ON E.healthcare_facility_id = HF.id JOIN Founding_Year FY ON HF.founding_id = FY.id

candidates.meaning: Show all employee names, positions, and the founding year of their respective healthcare facilities.
candidates.sql: SELECT e.employee_name, e.position, f.founding_year FROM Employees e JOIN Healthcare_Facilities h ON e.healthcare_facility_id = h.id JOIN Founding_Year f ON h.founding_id = f.id
